# Economic System Rework: Economic Sphere window and faction-screen button (generated by sphere.py)
scripted_gui = {
	won_sphere = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "won_sphere_window"
		visible = { has_country_flag = won_show_sphere has_country_flag = won_ready }
		dirty = won_sp_dirty
		effects = {
			won_sp_close_click = { clr_country_flag = won_show_sphere }
			won_sp_back_click = { won_lg_open = yes }
			won_sp_dir1_click = { won_sphere_set_dir1 = yes }
			won_sp_dir2_click = { won_sphere_set_dir2 = yes }
			won_sp_dir3_click = { won_sphere_set_dir3 = yes }
			won_sp_min1_click = { won_sphere_set_min1 = yes }
			won_sp_min2_click = { won_sphere_set_min2 = yes }
			won_sp_min3_click = { won_sphere_set_min3 = yes }
		}
		triggers = {
			won_sp_dir1_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_dir_cd } has_political_power > 49 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 1 } } }
			won_sp_dir2_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_dir_cd } has_political_power > 49 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 2 } } }
			won_sp_dir3_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_dir_cd } has_political_power > 49 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 3 } } }
			won_sp_min1_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_min_cd } has_political_power > 99 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 1 } } }
			won_sp_min2_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_min_cd } has_political_power > 99 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 2 } } }
			won_sp_min3_click_enabled = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_min_cd } has_political_power > 99 NOT = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 3 } } }
		}
		properties = {
			won_sp_gauge = { frame = won_sp_frame }
		}
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}

	won_sphere_fbtn = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "won_sphere_fbtn_window"
		parent_window_name = "countryfactionview"
		visible = { has_country_flag = won_ready }
		effects = {
			won_sphere_fbtn_click = { won_sphere_open = yes }
		}
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}
}
